demands.title: CI fix: Windows package job invokes build-msi.ps1 via PowerShell
demands.note: CI Windows leg fixed statically: PowerShell invocation of build-msi.ps1 plus rustup show and cargo install cargo-wix. No remote created, nothing pushed, no tag. The workflow has still never executed. CONTINUATION 2026-09-12: remote origin created by the user (private). First matrix run exposed two real breaks. (1) Windows cargo fmt failed on every file: rustfmt.toml sets newline_style=Unix but there was no .gitattributes, so the Windows checkout wrote CRLF. Fixed with '* text=auto eol=lf'. (2) macos-13 is a DEAD runner label (fully unsupported since 2025-12-04), so that job queued forever; moved to macos-15, which is arm64, which in turn exposed that the workflow hardcoded dist/lasercad-x86_64.dmg while build-dmg.sh emits lasercad-aarch64.dmg on arm64 -- a latent break that would have hit on the v0.1.0 tag push. Also bumped checkout v4->v5 and the artifact actions off the Node 20 runtime, and added repository= to Cargo.toml plus the README CI badge. Commits 958fb12, 4244d40, 0a1d680. CI now GREEN on ubuntu-24.04 + windows-2022 + macos-15 for both test and build: run 34727477158.

demands.title: Command-line parser (pure kernel module): X,Y / @X,Y / distance / aliases / toggles / zoom
demands.note: ADR 0003 (ac9e796) binds this: module at src/cmdline/, joins the AGENTS.md purity list; ToolKind enum + tools::make() retires BOTH ui/shortcuts.rs::TOOL_KEYS string mapping AND ui/toolbar.rs::make_tool. Refined 36b0056. Product calls: '.' is always the decimal separator and ',' always the coordinate separator, no locale detection; the recall ring is a transcript (duplicates kept, Unknown pushed, Empty not); 'e' maps to Delete and EXTEND gets no alias (v2 binds Key::E to DeleteTool). SHIPPED 66af950; review returned REWORK REQUIRED on one blocking finding and the fix landed as 29ac39a. Reviewer ran six mutation probes and all bit correctly: comma-as-decimal, ring de-dup, e->Extend, a removed ToolKind arm (compile error, no wildcard), and a broken TOOL_KEYS loop (the headless tests/lcv110.rs test caught it, so it is not tautological). The blocking finding was that a blank push left the recall cursor untouched; v1's command-line.ts:192-196 resets historyIndex unconditionally on every Enter, so push() now resets the cursor before the blank-entry early return. 632 -> 661 lib tests. CI green all three platforms (run 34729102013). APPROVED after rework.

demands.title: Wire the parser into the tools: on_command_input, per-phase prompts, focus-on-typing
demands.note: Biggest demand of Marco 1. ADR 0003 §B fixes on_command_input(ToolInput, &mut Document, &mut History) -> bool; tools never see a string. Prompts use the EXISTING Tool::status_text() pull model (§C); the real gap is CircleTool/ArcTool inheriting name(). Focus: the tool shortcut WINS over command-line focus, so the AC reads 'any alphanumeric that is NOT a bound tool shortcut'. product-owner added anchor() to Move/Circle/Arc but REFUSED it for Rect (ortho would collapse a rect to zero width/height), with a follow-up for architect to split the two meanings of anchor(). RISK: this demand leaves TEXT non-functional until LCV-112 lands, so LCV-112 is not optional. SHIPPED 533e24a + 2f39e9d; review returned REWORK REQUIRED on one blocking finding, fixed in d6a23b7. The finding was spec drift, not a design error: AC 9.4's 'Empty is never pushed' was written in dbf6a7a BEFORE the LCV-110 rework 29ac39a changed CommandHistory::push to reset the recall cursor on a blank entry, so guarding the call site made that already-approved behaviour unreachable in production. Reviewer checked v1 directly and found it does two things on one Enter: command-line.ts:192-196 resets historyIndex unconditionally, while execute() at 76-86 has its own separate blank guard before appending. Reviewer also confirmed the tests/lcv103.rs rename is a legitimate supersession and strictly more discriminating, and that the RECT no-anchor decision rests on a true premise (RectTool::on_pointer_down does discard at or below EPSILON). 661 -> 704 lib tests, 68 -> 86 integration. APPROVED after rework.

demands.title: TEXT complete: raw-input mode for string then height, single undo
demands.note: ADR 0003 §D raw-input mode. Height range 0.1..2000 mm, empty means 5.0; out of range keeps the operator's string and re-prompts, never clamps. Exactly one undo entry. Deletes Tool::on_text_input, which LCV-111 is explicitly forbidden from removing. Refined 36b0056.

demands.title: Hershey glyph table: 22 glyphs render below the baseline
demands.note: Defect found during the LCV-112 review, predates it (shipped by LCV-055). src/text/layout.rs places the text origin ON the baseline and maps py = origin.y - hy*scale, so any glyph datum with hy>0 renders BELOW the baseline. 22 of 62 alphanumeric glyphs violate the file's own documented convention (baseline y=0, caps top y=-9, x-height y=-6, descenders y~+4): 0 5 6 8 9 O Q S a b c d e o s t u overshoot with no descender at all, and g j p q y descend to +10/+6/+9/+9/+6 instead of +4. 'O' literally spans y=[-9..9], i.e. a 10mm O is 20mm tall with half below the line. Not a uniform offset -- checked, no affine map repairs 'O' -- so the data is corrupt per-glyph and must be re-authored, not shifted. Survived since LCV-055 because the only cap-height test (layout.rs h_cap_height_matches_height_mm) uses 'H', one of the 40 CORRECT glyphs. Acceptance must be a mechanical whole-table invariant test, not per-glyph eyeballing. Severity comparable to the mirrored-SVG defect D1 closed in Marco 0: it is visible in every exported SVG and in LaserGRBL.

demands.title: Confirm discard on New / Open / Exit when the document is dirty
demands.note: Refined 27f2a85. product-owner found that History::revision()/dirty_since is NOT usable as a discard guard: autosave's flush_if_due calls mark_clean() every ~800 ms, so the prompt window would be sub-second. Introduces an independent App::saved_revision written only by mark_saved(). Requires a new src/app/file_ops.rs because src/app/mod.rs is at 293 of the 300 cap.

demands.title: Configurable bed size (1..2000 mm), persisted in the SVG width/height and read on import
demands.note: Refined 27f2a85. Bed size owned by Document::bed_mm (undoable, round-trips); Settings::default_bed_mm seeds File>New and cold boot only; App::bed removed. Default STAYS 400x400 (renamed DEFAULT_BED_*_MM) because re-baselining to v1's 128 would rewrite every LCV-100/LCV-057 golden fixture for zero user gain. flip_y becomes flip_y(y, bed_height_mm). Import precedence width+height > viewBox > 400x400; out-of-range is REJECTED not clamped; opening a file adopts its bed. Implementer updates the AGENTS.md LaserGRBL/SVG checklist.

demands.title: Export preset selector (cut / mark / engrave) for the whole document
demands.note: Refined 27f2a85. Whole-document export-time preset only; per-entity preset is an explicit Non-goal with a forward pointer. State on App::export_preset, SESSION-ONLY (a sticky preset means yesterday's mark job cuts today's part), always shown as a status-bar label. Depends on LCV-114 for the shared ImportedSvg return type.

demands.title: Chrome: clickable SNAP/GRID/ORTHO statusbar toggles, autosave indicator, F1 shortcuts dialog, View zoom in/out
demands.note: Refined 27f2a85. product-owner found View>Zoom in/out ALREADY SHIPPED, so (d) shrank to a regression test plus the one real gap: Ortho/F8 has no checkbox where Grid/F7 and Snap/F3 do. Autosave indicator is three permanent states from a pure format_autosave(), no 'Ns ago' counter and no fade. Also found a latent defect: flush_if_due only runs inside a frame and nothing schedules one, so an idle dirty app may never autosave -> AC 9/10 require request_repaint_after().
